segment.text: Device pairing and network configuration details: When you discover, pair, and configure products through Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, or other local communication technologies using the app, we may process device model information, device names you assign, MAC addresses, firmware versions, and essential network parameters required for configuration (e.g., Wi-Fi SSID, encryption type, and IP address). In some operating systems, platform providers may group technical permissions for Bluetooth/Wi-Fi scanning with location permissions. In such cases, we only use the fundamental Bluetooth and network data needed to search nearby devices and connect them to your account and home network, without employing these permissions to obtain precise GPS coordinates or track your location. Product and service use information: the features you use, actions you take, and activities you perform. When your device is connected to our services, our services will collect various device event data through the App, such as when the device is used, whether it is turned on or off, and when it is capturing environmental information, motion, battery life or other information. When you set a device scene, we may collect the scene name, conditions, executed actions, and effective period you set. For cameras, if you bind the product to your App and activate the cloud storage service, you can log in to your cloud storage account in the App and bind your camera product with the service package. According to your subscription plan, when you use the camera product, the videos you take will be uploaded and stored in your cloud storage space. When a video is uploaded from your camera product to the cloud storage space, only those who have access to your cloud storage account (you and the person authorized by you) can log into your cloud storage account at any time to view or download the videos, the system will also automatically delete expired videos. If you have not activated the cloud storage service, the preview images of the event videos captured by your camera will be temporarily stored on the server and transmitted to your APP as needed to provide you with event notifications. Only the personnel with access to your camera product account (you and those you have authorized) can view and download the preview images. The system will also automatically delete the expired preview images.We will keep operation logs for a fixed period (e.g., 30 days). Previous logs will be overwritten. For products and functions such as AI hubs that require the use of cameras to collect home videos, we typically anonymize your personal data before processing and collecting it.please carefully read the corresponding prompts, privacy agreements or related documents in the APP, fully consider the risks, and then make an authorization decision. We will only collect your data and activate the corresponding functions after obtaining your consent. You have the right to withdraw your consent at any time. You can follow the path shown on the interface at that time to operate.

segment.text: For home robot products, we may collect information about the robot's movement throughout the environment and spatial information, and combined with your specification, to create its location map, prohibited areas, clean areas, types of obstacles encountered (if equipped with cameras) and obstacles location; we store the name you give your device and the name of its regional location. Some of our robot products may be equipped with cameras, and this processing is necessary in order to adopt obstacle detection and avoidance technology and improve the cleaning performance of the robot. Unless you have consented to activate other features, when the AI function is turned on, the camera is only used to provide visual information to help the robot detect and avoid obstacles, and identify the types and locations of objects such as furniture and appliances to help with more precise cleaning. It does not collect pictures and videos in your home, and users or others cannot view these pictures and videos, and these data will not be provided to other third-party platforms for use. When the AI function is turned off, the camera will no longer work. For smart lock, keypad, and smart doorbell, the fingerprint and facial recognition data collected are only stored on the device side, for the purpose of verifying your identity. We will not collect any of your personal information. To trigger certain automation, you may need to select a city to meet the automation trigger conditions you set, such as sunrise or sunset times. For location-based products or functions like the automatic unlocking (beta) feature of Lock Pro or Lock Ultra, we may need to obtain your App's geographical location authorization in order to implement product functions. Please note that we use geo-fencing technology to provide these automated services. You can set the fence area your choice, such as "within 2 kilometers of a specific address."When you enter the geo-fencing area, we will trigger the corresponding function according to the automated function you set. Please be aware that we will not collect and store your location information, and only use geo-fencing technology to identify whether you are close to the set area. Some products use location information for purposes such as time/date and language preferences. These information may include location information represented by your Wi-Fi or IP address, or low-precision data indicating the approximate area of your location (such as the city or region where you are located). We also offer activation and registration through third-party open licensing services such as Google, Amazon or Apple. Error reports and performance data：the type or severity of the problem, details of the software or hardware related to an error, the contents of files you were using when an error occurred.

segment.text: The right to object: You may object to the processing of your personal data on the grounds of legitimate interests (GDPR Article 6(1)(f)) based on your specific circumstances. Upon receiving your objection, we will assess and cease the relevant processing unless we can demonstrate that there exists a compelling legitimate reason whose importance outweighs your interests, rights, and freedoms, or that the processing is necessary to establish, exercise, or defend a legal claim. Right to object to direct marketing: You have the right to object unconditionally to the processing of your personal data (including user profiles) for direct marketing purposes at any time. If we conduct such marketing, we will clearly inform you of this right when we first contact you, and once you object, we will immediately stop processing your data for this purpose. Right to lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority: If you believe our processing of your personal data violates the GDPR, you may file a complaint with the data protection authority in the EU Member State where you habitually reside, work, or where the alleged infringement occurred. For example, if you reside in Germany, you may file a complaint with the Bavarian Data Protection Authority (BayLDA). You can find the contact details of all competent authorities through the official EU directory of authorities. Furthermore, you also have the right to exercise other corresponding personal information rights in accordance with the local data protection laws of your country. For the above requirements, you can contact us directly through the communication method at the bottom of this page. We may first ask you to verify your identity and process your request after successful verification to ensure security. We do not charge fees for your reasonable data requests, but we may charge a certain cost for requests that exceed reasonable limits. We have the right to refuse data requests that require complex technical means or affect existing service systems, bring risks or losses to the legitimate rights and interests of others, or are impractical. If you need to delete your account, please contact our customer service through the website. or click "Profile - Manage Accounts - Delete Account" in the App. Unless otherwise stipulated by laws and regulations, after you delete your account, we will stop providing you with our products and/or services.
